title: Capcom says it will use generative AI to speed up production but will not implement AI-generated assets
content: Capcom has announced it will use generative AI tools to accelerate its game production pipeline, but has clarified it will not implement assets directly generated by AI in its games. The company states the technology will be used for internal development processes such as research and planning rather than final in-game content. This follows scrutiny of AI asset usage in Resident Evil Requiem and other Capcom titles.
